notablePrerequisites: You are able to cast The Prismatic Piper for {0} due to Rakdos.
description:
Cast The Prismatic Piper from the command zone by paying {0}.
Warstorm Surges triggers, dealing 3 damage to any target opponent.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing The Prismatic Piper.
Choose to have The Prismatic Piper return to command zone.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia's ability, causing target player to mill three cards.
Repeat.
